name: Aiso
description:
Aiso is an AI Search Optimization platform that helps you understand how AI-powered search engines see your brand. Connect Aiso to monitor your visibility across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and other LLM-based search tools.

With the Aiso connector, Claude can:

- List and manage your tracked projects (domains)
- View AI visibility snapshots showing how your brand ranks across AI search engines
- Analyze competitor visibility and compare performance
- Review and manage prompt tracking configurations
- Generate topic-based prompts for monitoring
- Access detailed search result data including citations, rankings, and sentiment

Use Aiso to stay on top of how AI recommends (or overlooks) your brand, identify optimization opportunities, and track improvements over time.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Aiso to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Aiso to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.getaiso.com/api/v1/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Aiso MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Aiso lists 19 MCP tools, including add_prompts, brand_visibility_report, create_project, domain_report, generate_topic_prompts, get_access, get_fanout_metrics, get_fanouts_context, get_project, list_brands, list_projects, and list_prompts.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Aiso?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Aiso in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Aiso requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Aiso is developed by AISO Boost Ltd.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
